Hi Amelia / Tom,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — appreciated the thoughtful run-through of HelixData's realtime scoring use case. I promised to send a short recap + a clear next-step ask, so here it is.

Recap (high level):
- Goal: reduce model inference cost per decision while keeping 95th pct latency under 120ms for production scoring.
- Workload: 200–500 qps steady, occasional 2k qps spikes during batch runs.
- Key constraints: PII-in-transit requirements, audit logs for data lineage, pilot must not touch raw customer data.

Fit signals we heard:
- You need predictable per-decision latency more than absolute best-in-class throughput.
- You're open to a short pilot if we can demonstrate latency + cost delta on a sampled workload.

Proposed next steps (pick one):
1) 15-min technical sync w/ your infra lead to confirm data-handling and endpoint requirements (ideal: this week).
2) 30-day pilot: sample workload, we run on Dedicated capacity with a small dataset + synthetic substitution for PII. Deliverable: latency/cost report + runbook.

Attachments: discovery notes (20261120-helixdata-discovery-notes.pdf) and a short pilot proposal (pilot-proposal-HelixData-v1.pdf).

Quick ask: Can you share which of the two options above you'd prefer and a 15-minute slot (or I can send a Calendly link)? If now is not the right time, a one-line update on priority for Q4 vs Q1 is totally fine.
